verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's docs confirm DLSS 4 AI upscaling is supported on this Blackwell-based card, but there's no mention of frame generation modes, no FSR support, and no list of supported games or broad game compatibility — this is a professional workstation GPU with no gaming-focused benchmarks or driver notes in evidence. missing for 10: FSR/frame-generation details, documented game compatibility list, independent gaming benchmarks.
